properties.notes: Site within Bedlington town centre that is vacant following earlier clearance. Originally occupied by a Tesco foodstore, this was demolished a number of years ago, the remainder being existing a car park and area of vacant land. Redevelopment to provide a mixed-use scheme has been proposed. An original outline consent was approved for a wide range of uses including retail, commercial, business, and leisure as well as up to 12 dwellings (17/00444/OUT). Two detailed permissions have now been granted for development, comprising phase-a and phase-b (19/04899/REM, 18/01658/REM). The residential element is included in phase-b, but the proposal has been reduced to 4 apartments (18/01658/REM). As a result of the lower yield it is now classified as a small site in the SHLAA.
properties.site-address: Land to north of Market Place, Bedlington
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
